messages.welcomeBody: 友達を招待し、有効招待数を増やして現金報酬を受取りましょう。友達がさらに招待するとあなたもボーナスを獲得できます。始め方はこちら：
messages.contact: 質問がありますか？サポートまでお問い合わせください
messages.step1Body: タスクページで専用の招待リンクまたはQRコードをコピーします。
messages.step2Body: リンクを送信するか、友達にQRコードをスキャンしてもらいます。
messages.step3Body: 友達があなたのリンクから登録すると、レベル1の招待になります。
messages.step4Body: 有効招待数がギフトのしきい値に達したら、受取可能になります。
messages.step5Body: 招待した友達がさらに招待すると、レベル2（×0.5）とレベル3（×0.25）のボーナスを獲得。
messages.step6Body: ホームまたはタスクページで進捗を確認。条件達成時にタップして受取 - 報酬は暗号資産ウォレットに送金されます。
messages.faq1q: 招待の進捗を確認するには？
messages.faq1a: タスクページを開くと、有効招待数とレベル別内訳が表示されます。
messages.faq2q: 有効招待数が総招待数より少ないのはなぜ？
messages.faq2a: 有効招待 = レベル1×1.0 + レベル2×0.5 + レベル3×0.25。レベルによって重みが異なります。
messages.faq3q: ウォレットの紐付方法は？
messages.faq3a: マイページ → ウォレットで、ネットワークを選択し暗号資産ウォレットアドレスを入力。
messages.faq4q: 報酬はいつ届きますか？
messages.faq4a: 受取後、管理者が審査・承認します。承認後、USDTが紐付ウォレットに送金されます。
messages.faq5q: 招待コードはどこにありますか？
messages.faq5a: マイページで招待コードを確認するか、タスクページから共有リンクをコピーできます。

termsContent.title: 1. Acceptance of Terms

You are solely responsible for maintaining the confidentiality of your login credentials and for all activities that occur under your account. You must notify us immediately of any unauthorized use of your account.

termsContent.title: 3. Platform Services
termsContent.body: The Platform connects users with e-commerce partners, enabling members to earn income by completing shopping tasks on partner platforms. Users may also earn commissions through our multi-level referral program. All earnings are subject to verification, and the Platform reserves the right to adjust or withhold rewards in cases of suspected fraudulent activity, returns, or chargebacks.

termsContent.body: The Platform operates a 3-tier referral program. Commissions are calculated as follows: Level 1 (direct referrals): 1.0% of referral activity. Level 2 (sub-referrals): 0.5%. Level 3 (sub-sub-referrals): 0.25%. Commission rates and structures may be adjusted at the Platform's discretion with prior notice. Commissions are credited only after successful verification of the referred user's activity.

You certify that all documents submitted are genuine and belong to you. Submitting falsified documents will result in permanent account suspension and forfeiture of all funds.

The Platform is not responsible for delays caused by third-party payment processors, banking institutions, or blockchain network congestion. legal.privacyTitle: プライバシーポリシー

privacyContent.title: 1. Information We Collect
privacyContent.body: We collect the following categories of information: (a) Account Information: email address, phone number, full name, and profile details you provide during registration; (b) Verification Data: government ID documents, selfie photos, and other KYC materials submitted for identity verification; (c) Transaction Data: deposit records, withdrawal requests, task completion history, commission earnings, and wallet addresses; (d) Referral Data: invitation records, team structure, and referral activity tracking; (e) Technical Data: IP address, browser type, device information, operating system, access timestamps, and usage patterns collected automatically through server logs and analytics. All data collection is conducted with transparency and for legitimate business purposes.

privacyContent.title: 2. How We Use Your Information
privacyContent.body: Your information is used exclusively for the following purposes: verifying your identity and preventing fraud; processing deposits, withdrawals, and commission payouts; maintaining your account and providing customer support; tracking referral activity and calculating multi-level commissions; improving the Platform's features, performance, and security; sending service-related notifications (we do not send marketing emails without opt-in consent); and complying with legal obligations, regulatory requirements, and law enforcement requests. We will never use your personal data for purposes beyond those disclosed in this policy without obtaining your explicit consent.

privacyContent.title: 3. Data Storage & Security
privacyContent.body: We implement industry-standard security measures to protect your data, including: encryption of data in transit using TLS 1.3; encryption of sensitive data at rest using AES-256; secure password hashing using bcrypt with appropriate salt rounds; regular security audits and vulnerability assessments; and strict access controls limiting data access to authorized personnel only. While we employ commercially reasonable safeguards, no method of electronic storage or transmission is 100% secure. In the event of a data breach, we will notify affected users and relevant authorities within the timeframe required by applicable law.

privacyContent.title: 4. Data Sharing & Disclosure
privacyContent.body: We do not sell, rent, or trade your personal information to third parties. We may share your data only in the following limited circumstances: with service providers who assist us in operating the Platform (payment processors, hosting providers, analytics services) under strict confidentiality agreements; when required by law, court order, or governmental regulation; to protect the rights, property, or safety of the Platform, our users, or the public; and in connection with a merger, acquisition, or sale of assets, provided the receiving party agrees to respect your personal data in a manner consistent with this policy.

privacyContent.title: 5. Data Retention
privacyContent.body: We retain your personal data only for as long as necessary to fulfill the purposes described in this policy. Account data is retained while your account is active and for a period of 90 days after account closure to resolve any outstanding matters. Transaction records may be retained for up to 7 years as required by applicable financial regulations. KYC documents are retained in encrypted storage for the duration of your account plus 5 years as required by anti-money laundering regulations. You may request deletion of your data at any time by contacting support, subject to legal retention requirements.

privacyContent.title: 6. Your Rights & Choices
privacyContent.body: Depending on your jurisdiction, you may have the following rights regarding your personal data: the right to access and receive a copy of your data; the right to correct inaccurate or incomplete data; the right to delete your data (subject to legal retention requirements); the right to restrict or object to certain processing activities; the right to data portability; and the right to withdraw consent where processing is based on consent. To exercise any of these rights, please contact us via Telegram @Shopping_Operations. We will respond within 30 days.

privacyContent.title: 7. Cookies & Tracking Technologies
privacyContent.body: We use essential cookies required for the Platform to function, including session management, authentication, and security. We do not use third-party advertising cookies or tracking pixels. You can control cookie preferences through your browser settings. Disabling essential cookies may prevent certain Platform features from functioning properly.

privacyContent.title: 8. International Data Transfers
privacyContent.body: Your data may be stored and processed in countries outside your country of residence. We ensure that appropriate safeguards, such as standard contractual clauses, are in place to protect your data when transferred internationally, in compliance with applicable data protection laws.

privacyContent.title: 9. Children's Privacy
privacyContent.body: The Platform is not intended for individuals under the age of 18. We do not knowingly collect personal information from minors. If we become aware that a minor has provided us with personal data, we will take steps to delete such information immediately.

privacyContent.title: 10. Contact & Complaints
privacyContent.body: For any privacy-related questions, concerns, or to file a complaint, contact our support team via Telegram @Shopping_Operations. You also have the right to lodge a complaint with your local data protection authority.

legal.aboutTitle: ギフトヘイブンについて

aboutContent.title: What We Do
aboutContent.body: Shopee Shopping Operations is a task-based earning platform that bridges e-commerce merchants with a network of engaged users. Our members earn real income by completing verified shopping tasks on partner platforms and by inviting others to join. Since launch, we have processed thousands of completed tasks and paid out substantial commissions to our community of active members worldwide.

aboutContent.title: How It Works
aboutContent.body: 1. Browse available shopping tasks in our Store, each displaying the item cost, expected profit, and estimated completion time. 2. Complete the purchase on the partner platform following the task instructions. 3. Receive your profit once the task is verified. 4. Scale your earnings by inviting friends — you earn a percentage of their activity across 3 levels. 5. Withdraw your earnings after completing KYC verification.

aboutContent.title: Our Mission
aboutContent.body: We believe that everyone's time and network has value. Our mission is to create accessible earning opportunities by connecting everyday consumers with the global e-commerce economy. We are building a platform where effort translates directly into income — transparently, reliably, and at scale.

aboutContent.title: Core Values
aboutContent.body: Transparency: Clear task descriptions, real-time earnings tracking, and honest commission structures. Integrity: Strict anti-fraud measures, verified task completion, and fair review processes. Community: We grow together — your success is our success, powered by a collaborative referral model. Innovation: Continuously improving our platform with better tasks, faster payouts, and smarter tools.

aboutContent.title: Our Team
aboutContent.body: We are a distributed team of e-commerce specialists, software engineers, and community operators working to make task-based earning accessible globally. Our team brings experience from leading e-commerce platforms, fintech companies, and social distribution networks.

aboutContent.title: Contact & Partnerships
aboutContent.body: For questions, support, or partnership inquiries, reach us on Telegram: @Shopping_Operations. We respond to all inquiries within 24 hours. Business partnerships: we welcome collaborations with e-commerce merchants, payment providers, and affiliate networks. For enterprise inquiries, please contact us via Telegram for direct communication with our partnerships team.

aboutContent.title: Platform Statistics
aboutContent.body: We maintain a rigorous verification process to ensure the integrity of our platform. All tasks are reviewed before payout, all referrals are validated for authenticity, and all KYC submissions are examined by trained reviewers. Our commitment to quality over quantity ensures a sustainable and trustworthy ecosystem for all members.
